scope: Read-only review of package selection, overlay, private Git preparation/push and public release verification. No credentials read or printed, no network writes or Git writes executed. Final blocks freeze is an acknowledged remaining dependency, not a defect.

checks.provenance: Text records, native masters, technical integration geometry inputs, font/shader bytes and font license notices are included by current selection rules; consumed AI boards are omitted. Native technical refs are not counted as newly painted images.
checks.packageIntegrity: Frozen file hashes rechecked before ZIP construction; archive CRC is checked. Public independent download reconstructs split bytes and checks full ZIP SHA256 plus every embedded file checksum.
checks.privateGit: GIT_DIR and GIT_INDEX_FILE target private publisher paths. commit-tree has no parent argument; rev-list count must equal 1. Shared image Git is not operated by reviewed scripts.
checks.remoteWriteGuard: Push reads current main/tag and requires each equal either the exact previous published commit or this prepared commit. Atomic push includes explicit force-with-lease constraints for both refs.
checks.releaseRetirement: Initial release assets retire only after full independent public download succeeded; old IDs/names/digests/sizes are compared and overlap with new asset IDs is forbidden.

limitations: This preflight is not a publication receipt. Final frozen manifest, gallery pass, actual remote commit/blob checks and independent download receipts must still be produced.
Credential scanning is a bounded pattern check of selected text; private .work paths and known credential filenames are also excluded.

changes: Omit superseded root-working/hud-working metadata from delivery.
Skip explicitly excluded obsolete QA images when local cleanup is rejected.
